title: 第1章 六种天赋选择一种第2章 这道题我会
content_zh:
;;
中华龙脊，鳌太线。
帐篷外，寒风呼啸。
帐篷里，一具体育生的身体逐渐冰冷僵硬。
这位体育生终究没有靠自己扛过鳌太线的寒风。
“还需要再沉淀啊！”
尸体无聊地睁开眼睛，敖鹏自顾自地说道。
他确实不是这具身体的原主人，只是一个同名同姓的人。
这具身体确实是死了，因为他不仅浑身逐渐僵硬。
穿越过来的他刚刚闭眼感受了半个小时，连心跳都停止了。
在这个寒风夜，在中华龙脊之上。
他借尸还魂了。
好消息是，体育生死之前打了求援电话。
坏消息是，救援队找到他时，必定要检查他的生命体征。
所以他要么直接被送到殡仪馆，要么被送到科学院，两个地方他都不想去。
他想要挣扎着站起身，看能不能自己走下山，然后装成人一样活着。
好消息是，他继承了原主的全部记忆。
坏消息是，他现在操纵自己，就像是运转着一台巨大的生锈机器，连基本的抬手动作都要费千斤力。
就在敖鹏思考该怎么脱困的时候。
帐篷外忽然响起了一道问候声。

“兄弟，你在吗？”
“谁？”
敖鹏警惕地问道，他拨弄了一下身前的手机，输入了密码。
现在是凌晨三点。
就算救援队再敬业，也不可能冒着这么大的风险来找他。
以前敖鹏肯定不相信鬼神之说。
但现在，敖鹏本身就是鬼神中的一环。
对面过了几秒没有回答，然后又问道。
“兄弟，你看我像人，还是像神？”
这次的声音更加兴奋，带着贪婪与狡诈。
得，遇上黄皮子讨封了。
content_en:
;;
Chinese Dragon's Backbone, Aotai Line.
Outside the tent, the cold wind howled.
In the tent, the body of an athlete gradually became cold and stiff.
After all, this sports student could not withstand the cold wind of Aotai Line on his own.
"It still needs to settle down!"
The corpse opened its eyes in boredom, and Ao Peng said to himself.
He is indeed not the original owner of this body, just a person with the same name.
This body was indeed dead, for not only was his whole body gradually becoming stiff.
After traveling through time, he just closed his eyes and felt it for half an hour, and even his heartbeat stopped.
On this cold windy night, on top of the Chinese Dragon's Backbone.
He has resurrected his body.
The good news is that Sports made a call for help before he died.
The bad news is that when the rescue team found him, they were sure to check his vital signs.
So he was either sent directly to the funeral home or to the Academy of Sciences, and he didn't want to go to either place.
He wanted to struggle to stand up, see if he could walk down the mountain by himself, and then pretend to be alive like a human being.
The good news is that he inherited all the memories of the original owner.
The bad news is that he is now operating himself like a huge rusty machine, and even the basic movement of raising his hand requires a lot of effort.
Just when Ao Peng was thinking about how to get out of trouble.
Suddenly a greeting sounded outside the tent.
"Brother, are you there?"
"Who?"
Ao Peng asked warily. He fiddled with the phone in front of him and entered the password.
It's three o'clock in the morning.
No matter how dedicated the rescue team was, they wouldn't be able to take such a big risk to find him.
Ao Peng definitely didn't believe in ghosts and gods before.
But now, Ao Peng himself is a link among ghosts and gods.
The other person didn't answer for a few seconds, and then asked again.
"Brother, do you think I look like a human being or do I look like a god?"
This time the voice was more excited, filled with greed and cunning.
Yes, I met Huang Pizi and asked for a seal.
